page_title: FRO 0-0 TOR | Frosinone v Torino 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.

90+5' Yann Karamoh (Torino) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Torino are awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Luca Massimi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Valentino Lazaro (Torino).
90+2' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
90+1' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Torino have a goal ruled out for offside!
89' Ivan Ilic (Torino) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
89' Luca Massimi blows for a foul after Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Torino.
88' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
88' Stefano Turati leaps to intercept the corner kick from Valentino Lazaro (Torino).
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Torino comes to nothing.

86' Demba Seck (Torino) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Torino.
84' Yann Karamoh (Torino) gets inside the box and tries to beat Stefano Turati with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
83' Here is a change. Ricardo Rodriguez is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to David Zima (Torino).
83' It will be a substitution. Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) is ready to enter the pitch as Simone Romagnoli walks off.
82' Torino failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
82' Torino will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
81' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Torino have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
79' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Raoul Bellanova (Torino).

76' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Vanja Milinkovic-Savic anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
75' Koffi Djidji (Torino) commits a rough challenge and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for an infringement.
73' Duvan Zapata (Torino) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Yann Karamoh (Torino) for Antonio Sanabria.
72' Substitution. Nikola Vlasic will be replaced by Demba Seck (Torino).
72' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Valentino Lazaro (Torino) replacing Mergim Vojvoda.
72' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Francesco Gelli is replaced by Karlo Lulic (Frosinone).
71' That will be all from Arijon Ibrahimovic who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone).
70' A pass lands at the feet of Ivan Ilic (Torino) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
65' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
64' Ivan Juric has decided to make a change. Koffi Djidji (Torino) replaces Samuele Ricci.
61' It is time for a substitution. Pol Lirola (Frosinone) is on for Luca Garritano.
57' Adrien Tameze (Torino) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Luca Massimi didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
57' Luca Massimi shows the yellow card to Luca Garritano (Frosinone) for a heavy challenge.
56' Today's referee Luca Massimi rightly decides to book Ivan Ilic (Torino) for his harsh tackle.
56' Luca Garritano (Frosinone) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
54' Samuele Ricci (Torino) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
51' A corner kick by Frosinone is thwarted by the well prepared Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino).

51' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who tips the ball around the post. The linesman makes the right call and Frosinone will have a corner.
50' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) is penalised for a foul. Luca Massimi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
48' Golden opportunity! Duvan Zapata (Torino) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
48' It looks like Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) saw red with that tackle. Luca Massimi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
47' Duvan Zapata (Torino) beats a few defenders in the penalty area and drives a low shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to make a wonderful save.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) sees a yellow card from Luca Massimi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
45+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' What a shot! Ivan Ilic (Torino) decides to unleash a long-range missile of a shot, but his effort smashes against the right post.

43' Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a comfortable save.
42' Matias Soule (Frosinone) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
42' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) commits a rough challenge and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul. Frosinone have a free kick.
39' Samuele Ricci (Torino) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
37' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Frosinone, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Luca Massimi blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Frosinone in a dangerous position.
34' Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
30' Chance! Luca Garritano (Frosinone) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
28' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
27' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) makes a rough challenge and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
23' Frosinone earn a corner.

23' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

21' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
21' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
19' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Frosinone, play can continue.
17' There's a break in play and referee Luca Massimi must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Frosinone using VAR. This could be interesting!
16' One of the Frosinone players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
16' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) uses the wrong choice of words while trying to explain something to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
15' Samuele Ricci (Torino) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
12' Dangerous play by Anthony Oyono (Frosinone). Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul. Torino have been awarded a free kick.

11' Duvan Zapata (Torino) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
9' Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
8' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
6' Samuele Ricci (Torino) commits a foul and Luca Massimi immediately signals a free kick.
4' Duvan Zapata (Torino) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the right post from close range.
3' There's an opportunity for Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
3' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Torino will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Luca Massimi.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
